rca.defect: At frozen request concurrency 16, each terminal effect opened an independent post-commit connection and collected eight PostgreSQL clock candidates concurrently. At least one effect had all eight candidate brackets above the frozen 1000000 ns bound, so strict causal validation failed closed.
rca.evidence_capture_gap: The runner persisted effect entities and causal events before validation but wrote the complete request receipt bundle only after validation. The exact over-bound candidate distribution therefore was not retained for this failed attempt and is not inferred.
rca.pool_ownership_verification: The write transaction had exited and released its pool connection before a distinct backend PID performed commit-timestamp and visibility readback. Warm frozen-concurrency testing observed 16 effects, zero pool timeouts, and distinct write/readback backend PIDs; the failure is not hidden by increasing the write pool or serializing all requests.
rca.remediation: Freeze a bounded parallel post-commit readback lane separate from the unchanged write pool, retain its acquire telemetry in every v4 receipt, assert the frozen 16-way path produces 16 effects with no acquire timeout and a selected candidate within 1000000 ns, and persist the complete pre-validation receipt bundle before strict projection.
